runtime: Docker Compose; real HTTP, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ and Java services

checks.name: Server quote uses DB rates, ignores forged client fare/distance/surge and has 120-second validity
Quote ownership, UUID, changed route/vehicle and expiration are enforced by real PostgreSQL
Quote expiry is checked after PostgreSQL row-lock acquisition
Eight concurrent bookings commit one trip and one outbox event; retry after expiry returns the same trip
Locked price survives completion, payment, notification and broker redelivery
CAR_4_SEAT price and matching preserve the vehicle type after driver rejection
CAR_7_SEAT price and matching preserve the vehicle type
Production background worker uses Redis GEO and real demand; excludes other vehicle/status/distant trips
Demand with zero available motorcycles uses the configured surge ceiling
Surge returns to 1x after the waiting demand clears
